## What changed?

Describe the public-facing text, navigation, accessibility, or layout change.

## Why is it useful?

Explain what a reader will understand or do more easily.

## How did you check it?

Mention relevant checks, such as desktop/mobile layout, link verification, or HTML validation.

## Could this change affect scientific meaning?

State whether this is presentation-only. If it changes a scientific statement or source identity, explain the evidence and request review from the appropriate project owner.
